### Problem

The release candidate v7.23.1 fails the release scenario `merge-queue` in what the engine did: its `until` or `expect` did not hold, or could no longer hold, so the lane releases nothing and `v7` stays where it is.
Reproduced by: https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/45162885895 scenario `merge-queue`.

### Scope

- The cause of the failure above, in the engine, fixed with a test that would have caught it.

### Out of scope

- Changing the gates or what they check.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given v7.23.1's candidate with the fix, when the release lane plays `merge-queue` in the test repository, then it passes and the lane releases it.

### Criticality

Critical
